entries.name: Selection of Correct Information from Advertisement
entries.intent: Evaluate understanding of information presented in an advertisement.
entries.stemPattern: 다음은 교육 이벤트 관련 광고 문자 내용이다. 이를 통해 알 수 있는 내용으로 옳은 것만을 <보기>에서 고른 것은?
templates: Which of the following statements is correct based on the advertisement?
variationTips: Use different types of advertisements or events.

entries.name: Selection of Correct Explanation from Data
entries.intent: Assess ability to interpret data related to TQM and Six Sigma.
entries.stemPattern: 다음 자료에 대한 설명으로 옳은 것만을 <보기>에서 있는 대로 고른 것은? (단, A는 TQM, B는 6시그마이다.)
templates: Which explanation is correct based on the given data?

entries.name: Identification of Incorrect Information from Journal
entries.intent: Identify incorrect information about a company from a journal excerpt.
entries.stemPattern: 다음은 월간 기술 저널 내용의 일부이다. 이를 통해 알 수 있는 ◯◯기업에 대한 설명으로 옳지 않은 것은?
templates: Which statement about the company is incorrect based on the journal?
variationTips: Use different types of companies or industries.

entries.name: Selection of Appropriate System Proposal
entries.intent: Determine the most appropriate system proposal based on a presentation.
entries.stemPattern: 위 발표를 통해 A 씨가 ◯◯회사에 구축 필요성을 제안한 시스템으로 가장 적절한 것은?
templates: Which system proposal is most appropriate based on the presentation?
variationTips: Include different types of systems or companies.

entries.name: Selection of Correct Explanation from Presentation
entries.intent: Evaluate understanding of information presented in a presentation.
entries.stemPattern: 위 발표 내용을 통해 알 수 있는 설명으로 옳은 것만을 <보기>에서 있는 대로 고른 것은?
templates: Which explanation is correct based on the presentation?
variationTips: Use different presentation topics or contexts.

entries.name: Selection of Appropriate Information from Strategy Document
entries.intent: Assess understanding of digital strategy in the textile and fashion industry.
entries.stemPattern: 다음은 섬유· 패션 산업의 디지털 전략 자료이다. 이를 통해 알 수 있는 내용으로 적절한 것만을 <보기>에서 있는 대로 고른 것은?
templates: Which information is appropriate based on the strategy document?
variationTips: Include different industries or strategic focuses.

entries.name: Selection of Appropriate System and Management Method
entries.intent: Identify the most appropriate production information system and quality management method.
entries.stemPattern: 다음은 기술 저널의 일부이다. ◯◯기업이 적용한 생산 정보 시스템과 품질 관리 방식으로 가장 적절한 것은?
templates: Which system and management method are most appropriate for the company?
variationTips: Use different systems or management methods.

entries.name: Identification of Students with Correct Responses
entries.intent: Determine which students responded correctly to all tasks.
entries.stemPattern: 다음 자료에 나타난 과제에 대해 모두 정답으로 응답한 학생은?
templates: Which student answered all tasks correctly based on the data?
variationTips: Include different types of tasks or student data.

entries.name: Selection of Correct Information from Automation Case
entries.intent: Evaluate understanding of information presented in a factory automation case.
entries.stemPattern: 다음은 공장 자동화 사례이다. ◯◯기업에 대한 내용으로 옳은 것만을 <보기>에서 있는 대로 고른 것은?
templates: Which statement about the company is correct based on the automation case?
variationTips: Use different automation cases or companies.

entries.name: Selection of Correct Unlock Pattern from Game
entries.intent: Identify the correct unlock pattern based on a game used in class.
entries.stemPattern: 다음 자료는 수업 시간에 사용된 게임의 일부이다. 이를 통해 알 수 있는 잠금 해제 패턴으로 옳은 것은?
templates: Which unlock pattern is correct based on the game?
variationTips: Include different types of games or patterns.

entries.name: Production Innovation Activities
entries.intent: Evaluate understanding of production innovation activities.
entries.stemPattern: 다음은 ○○기업의 생산 혁신 활동 사례이다. 이에 대한 설명으로 옳은 것만을 <보기>에서 있는 대로 고른 것은?
templates: Identify correct production innovation activities from the given options.
variationTips: Include different types of production innovation activities.

entries.name: Product Consulting Results
entries.intent: Assess understanding of product consulting outcomes.
entries.stemPattern: 다음은 ○○기업의 제품 컨설팅 결과이다. 이에 대한 설명으로 옳은 것만을 <보기>에서 있는 대로 고른 것은?
templates: Select the correct explanations of the consulting results from the given options.
variationTips: Vary the types of consulting results presented.

entries.name: Industrial Accident Case
entries.intent: Evaluate understanding of industrial accident cases.
entries.stemPattern: 다음 수업 장면에 나타난 산업 재해 사례에 대한 설명으로 옳은 것만을 <보기>에서 고른 것은?
templates: Identify the correct explanations of the industrial accident case from the given options.
variationTips: Include different types of industrial accident scenarios.

entries.name: Carbon Emission Analysis
entries.intent: Assess understanding of carbon emission analysis in manufacturing.
entries.stemPattern: 다음은 ○○기업의 제품 제조 과정 및 탄소 배출 현황을 나타낸 것이다. 이를 분석한 내용으로 옳은 것만을 <보기>에서 고른 것은?
templates: Select the correct analysis of carbon emissions from the given options.
variationTips: Vary the manufacturing processes and emission data presented.

entries.name: Company Case Analysis
entries.intent: Evaluate understanding of company case studies.
entries.stemPattern: 다음 사례를 통해 알 수 있는 ○○기업에 대한 내용으로 옳은 것만을 <보기>에서 있는 대로 고른 것은?
templates: Identify the correct information about the company from the given case study.
variationTips: Include different organizational and management scenarios.

entries.name: Production Information System
entries.intent: Assess knowledge of production information systems.
entries.stemPattern: 다음 기업용 솔루션 홍보 자료에 나타난 생산 정보 시스템으로 가장 적절한 것은?
templates: Select the most appropriate production information system from the given options.
variationTips: Include different types of production information systems.

entries.name: Fire Safety Education Analysis
entries.intent: Evaluate understanding of fire safety education cases.
entries.stemPattern: 다음 소방 안전 교육 사례에 대한 분석 내용으로 적절한 것만을 <보기>에서 있는 대로 고른 것은?
templates: Identify the correct analysis of the fire safety education case from the given options.
variationTips: Include different fire safety education scenarios.

entries.name: Idea Competition Poster Analysis
entries.intent: Assess understanding of idea competition details.
entries.stemPattern: 다음 ○○기업 아이디어 경진 대회 포스터를 통해 알 수 있는 내용으로 옳은 것만을 <보기>에서 있는 대로 고른 것은?
templates: Identify the correct information about the idea competition from the given poster.
variationTips: Include different types of competition details.

entries.name: Environmental Conservation Practices
entries.intent: Evaluate knowledge of international environmental agreements.
entries.stemPattern: 다음 기사에 나타난 환경 보전 실천 사례와 관련된 국제 협약으로 가장 적절한 것은?
templates: Select the most appropriate international agreement related to the environmental conservation practices from the given options.
variationTips: Include different environmental practices and related agreements.
